description: Data for: Safety Strategy of Power Transmission Channel Coordinated with Transfer Capability Support for Power System Emergency is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Jian Wang. Parameters of LGJ 400/35 type ACSR conductor; Example of safety overload capacity of the transmission line; The curve of temperature rise test for a current transformer; Conductor temperature rise curves of LGJ 400/35 due to a step current of 0–500–900 A; Example of bottleneck current of the transmission channel; Weather conditions of a district on ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
